To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
alkali activated steel slag concrete and alkali activated steel fly ash slag concrete are eco-friendly, durable and cost effective concrete mixes.

the AASC mixes containing steel slag aggregates displayed comparable performance as compared to the AASC mixes without steel slag aggregates and the AASFC mixes with steel slag aggregates performed better than the AASFC without steel slag aggregates.
the alkali-activated slag concrete mixes containing steel slags as coarse aggregates displayed superior durability properties and lower energy consumption as compared to conventional concrete mixes.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the durability performance of eco-friendly AASC and AAFSC mixes incorporating steel slag aggregates and its potential to replace conventional natural aggregates in concrete.
the use of steel slag as a sustainable construction material and it is found that steel slag can be used as coarse aggregates for AASC and for AASFC.
the durability of alkali activated slag mixes incorporating steel slag aggregates and it is found that the durability performance of these concrete mixes are comparable to OPCC.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the AASC mixes with steel slag aggregates could be a viable alternative to OPCC for structural applications in marine and aggressive environments.
the steel slag aggregate can be used as a partial replacement of natural aggregate in alkali activated concrete without any compromise on the durability of concrete.
steel slag aggregates are an excellent replacement material for conventional natural coarse aggregates in AASC and AAFSC.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
steel slag can be used as an eco-friendly aggregate substitute in alkali activated concrete.
the AASC mixes incorporating steel slag aggregates are suitable for structural applications and the AASFC mixes with steel slag aggregates are also suitable for non-structural applications.
the alkali activated slag mixes incorporating steel slag aggregates can be used as an alternative to conventional OPC mixes for structural purposes.
The main takeaway from our work is that
steel slag aggregates can be used in AASC and AASC mixes to reduce the environmental impact of construction industry.
the AASC mixes with steel slag aggregates can be used in construction of structural elements and the AASFC mixes can be used in the construction of pavements.

steel slag aggregates can be used as a partial replacement of natural aggregates in AASC and AASF concrete mixes without compromising the durability performance of the concrete mixes and also without increasing the production cost of the mixes.
